morbi.headline: Morbi cluster shows premium-led recovery amidst export volume contraction and fraud risks.
what_changed: Varmora Granito reported H1 profit surge driven by premium tile margins, indicating sector recovery for larger players.
Indian ceramic tile exports experienced a steep 46% volume drop during April-July 2026 with a weak FY27 outlook.
A Morbi tile manufacturer faced a credit fraud incident involving a Mumbai buyer defaulting on Rs 44.74 lakh.
stress_signals: Export volume drop of 46% between April and Jul 2026 threatens export-reliant MSMEs [434975bd08e0].
Liquidity and counterparty risk highlighted by a Rs 44.74 lakh credit fraud involving a vanished buyer [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito financial results and 498% H1 profit jump point to recovery driven by premium tiles [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Whether recovery indicators extend from large branded players to smaller MSME vitrified and wall tile producers.
Export volume trends and overseas demand recovery for the remainder of FY27.
Counterparty credit checks, receivables management, and buyer verification protocols for outstation orders.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces embroidery labour disputes, input cost spikes, and diamond export drops.
what_changed: Embroidery sector faced ongoing three-month labour disputes, protests, and worker detentions over wages and working conditions (8a31a5a2c20c, 7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7).
A 50% raw material cost spike triggered a month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers (48c63a4e50b6).
Diamond exports dropped by 7% amid a polished diamond shipment slump (975918f112f3).
stress_signals: Embroidery job-work machines halted due to a prolonged three-month labour dispute, risking cash inflows and debt service for small units (8a31a5a2c20c, e7921383cbb7).
Textile units reported operational disruptions from eight-hour power cuts (167f80ff6cdc).
A fire broke out at the Adinath Textile Market in Salabatpura, requiring 14 to 15 fire brigade vehicles (f36719f0f644).
A diamond factory owner filed a complaint against a Surat trader for defaulting on Rs 70,000 in processing wages (698c779932f2).
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and eased highway checks for Surat textiles (17f0a015a73c).
Textile sector exploring export growth via the India-New Zealand FTA and expanding into defence technical textiles (8e92d85d894d, 0f163b499572).
ICA-GemLab is setting up its first Indian laboratory in Surat (26bd1ecd549c).
what_to_watch: Resolution of the three-month embroidery labour agitation and impact on machine-loan servicing (8a31a5a2c20c, 442c4ff911f8).
Implementation and specific incentives of the upcoming state or central textile policy within three months (7cb0d1c51743).
Account-level cash flows and working capital utilization across weaving and texturizing units amid raw material cost spikes (48c63a4e50b6).
Polished diamond export trends and debt repayment behavior of regional trading accounts (975918f112f3).
